sam_sales: Heads-up: prospect (large payments co) requested a short POC with strict country-level residency for EU and Singapore. They want clarity on which subprocessors will see data in the POC, exact routing order, and whether hosted endpoints can be constrained to country borders for the trial. Also asked: will regional pinning affect pricing in a line-item way?

rita_solutions: Quick clarifiers: do they require BYOK for the POC or just for production? And does the customer require control-plane isolation?

sam_sales: For POC they're ok with platform-managed keys but need an auditable list of subprocessors and evidence of no-cross-border egress during test. Production will require BYOK and contractual residency terms.

omar_sre: ops note: For hosted we have regional affinity + failover policy. Default routing: same-country -> same-region -> nearest-region. We can enable a "regional-strict" flag for the POC so requests are rejected rather than failed over if target region is unavailable. That meets their "no-egress" test for the trial.

omar_sre: caveat: certain telemetry/control-plane traces may still hit central endpoints; we can mask/limit telemetry and provide a signed attestation for the POC. For full production with zero control-plane egress, Private (VPC) or on-prem control-plane is recommended.

rita_solutions: Example header to pin a request for POC:

```
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.com
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
X-Redwood-Region: ap-southeast-1
X-Redwood-Strict-Region: true
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model":"redwood-13b", "messages":[{ "role":"user","content":"..." }] }
```

zara_pm: Subprocessors: we'll share the CSV extract, but brief: cloud provider (region-specific), logging provider (contracted EU/APAC-only endpoints), monitoring agent vendor (we can disable for POC), and CDN edge (if used). Legal will need to sign DPA addendum for EU-only production.

legal_mike: Confirming: to advertise any EU-only residency SLA we require an addendum and explicit subprocessor list for the customer. For POC we can supply the list and an attestation letter. BYOK onboarding for EU usually 3-7 business days after contract and key material exchange.

omar_sre: Pricing: for POC no uplift if it's a short eval using hosted with regional-strict flag. For sustained regional pin (Dedicated reservation) expect uplift: dedicated regional pool + pinned tenancy = roughly +22% to +38% over baseline hosted per throughput profile. BYOK + per-tenant log retention/attestation = fixed professional services fee. I'll attach a short Ops estimate later.

infra_bot: Created ticket RED-POC-4412 (presales) and a shared runbook at https://internal.redwood/presales/RED-POC-4412. Assigned: @omar_sre @rita_solutions.

sam_sales: Two deliverables requested by prospect: (1) one-page subprocessor summary + CSV; (2) a short attestation that the POC will reject cross-border failover (we'll show test traces). Can we commit to both by EOD tomorrow?

rita_solutions: I'll prepare the one-pager and a sample cURL-based test script that produces pcap-friendly traces.

omar_sre: I'll draft the attestation language and the ops checklist: tunnel setup, IP allowlist, region header enforcement, telemetry mask. I'll also include the expected cost delta text for the deck.

legal_mike: I'll export subprocessor CSV and draft the DPA addendum template (POC attestation + production clause).

zara_pm: Sync call set for Fri 10:30 SGT to present the one-pager + attestation draft. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam_sales: Great, appreciate it.
